english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a person who has committed a crime.
This is the all-purpose casual choice for someone being held in a police or prison context, though it can also mean a criminal or suspect.
Use this as the usual spoken noun for someone who has broken the law.
This is the everyday all-purpose term for a person convicted of a crime, especially one in custody.
